Major Pratap Singh and his team are assigned duty at the India-Pakistan border. He has to defend his country and save fellow countrymen from a terrorist invasion.
Movie:- Maa Tujhhe Salaam (2002)
StarCast:- Tabu, Sunny Deol, Arbaaz Khan, Malaika Arora, Sudesh Berry

Produced By:- Mahendra Dhariwal
Music By:- Sajid–Wajid
